description: Resolve a ZIP / postal code to its place info — city, state/province, latitude/longitude — for any of 60+ countries. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "where is ZIP X" / "what city is postal code Y in" / "lat-lon for ZIP Z". Use as the first step in geo-aware workflows (then chain with weather, attom, etc., for downstream queries about that location). Free, sub-second, no auth.

zipcode.description: ZIP or postal code to look up (e.g. "90210").

name: lookup_zipcode
